plain: Every product we bring forward is dual-licensed: the open license, or a paid grant to ship closed. Hosted compression runs every pathway we own on this machine and keeps the smallest file that still restores. npm and MCP call that live host. AWARE year ($490) is the commercial grant for the hosted house. pulsar-exception and cuni-exception cover those trees. Chamber, Rider, and Warrant seats cover theirs.
rule: Dual license on every product we bring forward. Copyleft or a paid grant. Hosted compression uses every own pathway. Signing keys and live customer data stay operator-only.

dual.chooser: You pick copyleft or the commercial grant. Both are written.
